messages:
aisling: heads up — PR #426 (sdk/snippets/python-auth) failed docs CI: markdownlint + linkcheck. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/426
reno: what errors? paste the CI snippet
aisling: \n```
markdownlint: MD013/line-length: Line 47 exceeds 120 characters
linkcheck: Broken external link: https://old-oss.example.com/py-helpers -> 404 Not Found
```
karen: I remember we removed that helper package months ago. We should link to the new package page: https://packages.example.com/redwood-python-helpers
aisling: good catch. also the long line is the example curl block where we had a super long header comment. should wrap the comment and keep code lines short.
reno: I can do a small reformat commit (wrap comments, keep code at <= 100 chars) and update the link. pushing in 5.
ci-bot: build started for PR #426 (docs-preview + markdownlint + linkcheck)
docs-engager: FYI, if you reflow code fences, ensure we keep the triple-backticks and language tag for syntax highlighting. I've seen the preview change the font when missing.
reno: ack. will preserve ```python and the inline code blocks.
ci-bot: markdownlint fixed, linkcheck still failing: new link redirects with 302 and linkcheck treats redirects as warnings in our config. Log: https://ci.example.com/builds/9901/log
aisling: redirects are okay for the package index; can we update linkcheck config to allow that domain? or use canonical URL (with trailing slash)?
docs-engager: prefer canonical. use https://packages.example.com/redwood-python-helpers/ (with trailing slash). That avoids redirect.
reno: pushed commit 1782351288 — replaced link with canonical URL and wrapped comment lines.
ci-bot: preview: all checks passed. Ready for review.
karen: assigning @docs-engager for a quick content sanity check then LGTM.
docs-engager: skimmed — examples render, code blocks fine. Approving.
ci-bot: PR #426 merged by docs-bot at 1782351395.
aisling: thanks everyone. Note for next time: search repo for old-oss.example.com references and add a redirect note.
reno: opened follow-up issue #210 to sweep links across site.
aisling: perfect — closing this thread.
